input: Can I cancel an order that has already been shipped?
actual_output: Once an order has been dispatched (shipped), it cannot be cancelled through ShopAssist. However, if eligible, you can request a return after delivery under the Returns, Refunds & Exchanges Policy.
retrieval_context: A: Cancellation may be possible if it has not dispatched, but support needs to confirm the order status. I cannot cancel it directly.
Q: I placed my order an hour ago. Can you cancel it?
Once an order has been dispatched, it cannot be cancelled through ShopAssist. If eligible, the customer can request a return after delivery under the Returns, Refunds & Exchanges Policy.
